metrics.name: Beats and density (T0 runs of roam, smart, smart+P, focus, dash, evolve)
metrics.value: beats off-rule 0; alive max 533; over row maxAlive 83 (row of the minute: 275); saturated share max 0.212
metrics.target: beats on time or per deferral; alive <= row.maxAlive + 160 (inside a cage, the row in force when it rose) and <= 610; saturated share <= 0.25

metrics.name: Density band (smart+P median free-field alive per minute vs the A7.2 Target alive; free field = steps with no cage and no lull)
metrics.value: hive 9/9 (minute mean 4/9), depths 9/9 (minute mean 6/9), wastes 9/9 (minute mean 7/9)
metrics.target: in band in 3 of 4 scored minutes (7 of 9; the cage rows 4, 7 and 11 have no band)

metrics.name: Boss arrival (smart+P and focus fights)
metrics.value: 406 arrivals, 294 to 437 u, cage active and inside 406/406, in arena 406/406
metrics.target: 250 to 340 u; cage active the same tick

metrics.name: Fights (focus bot medians mid1/mid2/final; default bot = smart+P)
metrics.value: hive focus 25.2/20.5/81.8 s (kills 29/24/20), default longest 180 s; depths focus 23.2/16.7/36.4 s (kills 30/16/13), default longest 203.3 s; wastes focus 20.9/23.8/73.9 s (kills 29/22/16), default longest 180 s; kill-to-next-arrival min 48.1 s
metrics.target: focus mid1/mid2 median 20 to 40 s, final 40 to 75 s; default bot none over 150 s except stalemate; gap >= 20 s

metrics.name: Win rate (30 seeds per world)
metrics.value: hive smart+P 5/30, smart 2/30; depths smart+P 12/30, smart 7/30; wastes smart+P 15/30, smart 3/30

metrics.name: Median survival (a win or a stalemate counts as the whole 14:00)
metrics.value: hive smart 14:00, smart+P 14:00, crude 2:08; depths smart 7:40, smart+P 9:23, crude 2:10; wastes smart 10:17, smart+P 14:00, crude 1:45
metrics.target: smart >= 5:30; smart+P >= 8:00; crude >= 2:30; Hive crude >= Depths and Wastes

metrics.name: Level curve (smart+P median level; a run that won earlier counts its final level)
metrics.value: hive L10/L20/L24 at 3:00/8:00/11:00, gap over 60 s in 21/30 runs; depths L11/L21/L26.5 at 3:00/8:00/11:00, gap over 60 s in 15/30 runs; wastes L11/L19/L24 at 3:00/8:00/11:00, gap over 60 s in 18/30 runs
metrics.target: L9 to 12 at 3:00; L18 to 23 at 8:00; L23 to 28 at 11:00; no gap over 60 s after 1:00

metrics.name: Readable deaths (smart-family deaths; crude in the details)
Speed (T0 runs before OVERTIME; streams, charger dash and the boss lunge exempt)
